cavitation_floor.class: IDENTITY (parameter-free root of the CANDIDATE Propulsion EOS)

closure_A_v_const.description: v_theta = c0 (rigid lock at trapped-photon speed); the ONLY scale-free closure (c0^2, rho0, Omega all cancel)
closure_A_v_const.fit_tell: R/r = phi^2 requires rho_wall ~= 0.4401, which is NOT a canonical density (not 1/phi, not 1/phi^2, not a saturation root). Forcing phi^2 is therefore FITTED, not forward.

closure_B_solid_body.description: v_theta = Omega*r (cavprobe config); the balance pins (Omega^2/2c0^2)*(R^2 - r^2), a dimensional combination, NOT the ratio R/r
closure_B_solid_body.free_input: edge Mach M_edge = Omega*r/c0 (sets R/r at fixed R^2-r^2)

verdict.missing_physical_input: the OUTER saturation-wall density rho_wall AND the circulation/velocity profile law v_theta(r). The cavitation-floor inner BC (rho_cav=-1/phi) is one constraint; a pure ratio R/r needs a second independent canonical BC. No canonical pair tested lands on phi^2; forcing it needs rho_wall~=0.440 (non-canonical) -> fitted.
verdict.class: cannot be graded emergence; inputs do not close the ratio
verdict.coordinate_check: R/r is a REAL-SPACE O_1 unknot major/minor ratio compared to the REAL-SPACE Golden-Torus phi^2 -> coordinate-matched; the (2,3) phase winding does NOT enter this balance.
